exercises.name: EGYM Squat
exercises.mechanics: Stand on the platform with the pads on your shoulders, feet hip-width apart. Log in with your wristband and use the Classic method. At the end of the set, type the tonnage the screen shows.

exercises.name: EGYM Lat Pulldown
exercises.mechanics: Sit with the thigh pad on your thighs. Pull the handles down to your upper chest. Log in with your wristband and use the Classic method. At the end of the set, type the tonnage the screen shows.

exercises.name: EGYM Leg Curl
exercises.mechanics: Sit with the thigh pad on your thighs and the lower pad above your heels. Bend the knees against the pad. Log in with your wristband and use the Classic method. At the end of the set, type the tonnage the screen shows.

exercises.name: EGYM Chest Press
exercises.mechanics: Sit with your back on the pad. Press the handles forward. On the way back, the right arm goes only as deep as is easy. Log in with your wristband and use the Classic method. At the end of the set, type the tonnage the screen shows.

exercises.name: EGYM Leg Press
exercises.mechanics: Sit with your back on the pad and your feet on the plate, hip-width apart. Press the plate away. Log in with your wristband and use the Classic method. At the end of the set, type the tonnage the screen shows.

exercises.name: EGYM Row
exercises.mechanics: Sit with your chest on the pad. Pull the handles to your ribs. Log in with your wristband and use the Classic method. At the end of the set, type the tonnage the screen shows.

exercises.name: EGYM Glute Press
exercises.mechanics: Set the waist pad at your hips. Push the hip open to straight, then come back under control. Log in with your wristband and use the Classic method. At the end of the set, type the tonnage the screen shows.

exercises.name: EGYM Triceps Dip
exercises.mechanics: Sit tall and hold the handles at your sides. Push down until the arms are straight. The elbows stay at or in front of the line of the body. Log in with your wristband and use the Classic method. At the end of the set, type the tonnage the screen shows.

exercises.name: EGYM Leg Extension
exercises.mechanics: Sit with your back on the pad and the shin pad above your ankles. Straighten the knees. Log in with your wristband and use the Classic method. At the end of the set, type the tonnage the screen shows.

exercises.name: EGYM Biceps Curl
exercises.mechanics: Sit with your upper arms on the pad. Curl the handles up. Log in with your wristband and use the Classic method. At the end of the set, type the tonnage the screen shows.

exercises.name: EGYM Hip Abductor
exercises.mechanics: Sit with the pads on the outside of your knees. Push the knees out. Log in with your wristband and use the Classic method. At the end of the set, type the tonnage the screen shows.

exercises.name: EGYM Hip Adductor
exercises.mechanics: Sit with the pads on the inside of your knees. Start only as wide as you control, then squeeze the knees in. Log in with your wristband and use the Classic method. At the end of the set, type the tonnage the screen shows.

exercises.name: EGYM Back Extension
exercises.mechanics: Sit with the pad on your upper back and your hips held by the pad. Push back to upright. Log in with your wristband and use the Classic method. At the end of the set, type the tonnage the screen shows.

exercises.name: EGYM Abdominal Crunch
exercises.mechanics: Sit with your feet under the bars and your chest on the pads. Curl the chest toward the hips. Log in with your wristband and use the Classic method. At the end of the set, type the tonnage the screen shows.

note: Two rounds, one set on each machine. Log in with your wristband and use the Classic method, so the tonnage is exact. After each set, type the tonnage the screen shows. In round 1 you can change the order; round 2 follows the order you used.
